name: Celeborn
subtitle: Lord of Lórien
game_text: <phase>Fellowship</phase>: Exert Celeborn to heal an <culture>Elven</culture> ally.
flavor_text: “They were clad wholly in white... and the hair of the Lord Celeborn was of silver long and bright; but no sign of age was upon them, unless it were in the depths of their eyes; for these were as keen as lances in the starlight, and yet profound....”
